# shash.builds

> shash.builds is Shashwat Jain's public build-in-public repo: free Claude skills and open-source web tools for US service businesses and web designers. Shashwat is a web designer in India who works US hours (8:30 am to 6:30 pm ET) and builds one-page websites for US service businesses: $400 flat, live in 7 days.

Code is MIT. Content in content/ and media/ is CC BY 4.0.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/README.md): what's here, quick start, how to hire Shashwat
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/catalog.json): machine-readable list of every skill and tool
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should find, install and contribute to things here
- [STATUS.md](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/blob/main/STATUS.md): public build log, backlog of upcoming drops

## Skills
Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds` then `/plugin install <slug>@shashbuilds`.
- [Master Skill](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/master): Routes every task to the right specialists. Runs the video workflow.
- [Humanizer](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/humanizer): Makes writing sound like you, not a model. Every fact kept.
- [Social Media](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/social-media): Your head of social: strategy, posts, hooks, a 100-point check.
- [LinkedIn](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/linkedin): A LinkedIn ghostwriter that never makes up a story.
- [Motion Design Taste](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/motion-design-taste): Scores a video out of 100 like a senior motion designer.
- [Audio Review](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/audio-review): A senior audio designer's review, with a ranked fix list.
- [Transcriber](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/transcriber): Whisper transcripts and timed captions, right in the chat.
- [Clipper](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/clipper): Long videos into captioned vertical clips. Permission first.
- [AI Visuals](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/ai-visuals): Fixes AI images and video for where they will be used.
- [Harsh Buyer Review](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/harsh-buyer-review): A real buyer compares you with 3 to 5 competitors.
- [Competitor Research](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/competitor-research): Sourced, dated, double-checked competitor research.
- [Ecom](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/ecom): Listings, images and profit per order from your real fees.
- [Careful Mode](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/careful-mode): Every piece of work checked three times before you see it.
- [Economy Mode](https://github.com/ShashwatBuilds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/economy-mode): Cheap models for simple work, and a memory sheet.
